en: Launch: it charges for %d:%02d, and every dinosaur in the valley comes for the cabin, from every side — %s last of all. Full charge, and the capsule jumps.
zh_CN: 启动：充能 %d:%02d，整个山谷的恐龙都会从四面八方扑向船舱，最后来的是%s。充满就跳。
已修 %d/%d 段 · 下一段 %s

en: The beacon is charging — they are coming from every side!
zh_CN: 信标开始充能——恐龙从四面八方来了！
第 %d 波结束——打死 %d 只 · 留下 %s · 损失 %s

en: The cabin: lose it and the run is lost
zh_CN: 船舱：船舱被毁，这一局就输了

en: Power %d%% — about %s days left. When it runs out, the run is lost.
zh_CN: 电能 %d%%：大约还能用 %s 天。电用完，这一局也输了。

en: The cabin's power is running low.
The engineer: if he dies, the run is lost. Click, or press %s, for all of him.
zh_CN: 工程师：人死了，这一局就输了。点这里或按 %s 看他的全部属性。

en: Right‐click the ground to walk there, a tree or rock to gather, a dinosaur to fight.
zh_CN: 右键点地面走过去，点树或石头采集，点恐龙战斗。

en: Asleep in the pod — health %s · stamina %s
zh_CN: 在营养舱里睡觉 · 生命 %s · 精力 %s

en: Right‐click it with the engineer selected to gather.
zh_CN: 选中工程师后右键点它，就去采集。
射速 %s/秒 · 射程 %s 米 · 伤害 %s

en: It only goes on while he is in the cabin
zh_CN: 人在船舱里，这活才会接着做

en: Tools — made once, his for good; the towers' ammunition, a batch at a time
zh_CN: 工具：做一次，一直带着；塔的弹药：做一批，用一批

en: Sleep in the nutrient fluid: it mends him and rests him — and nothing else gets done meanwhile
zh_CN: 躺进营养液睡一觉：回血也回精力——这期间别的都干不了

en: He is unhurt and rested: no need to sleep.
zh_CN: 他没受伤也不累，不用睡。

en: Sleep in the pod: health and stamina full again in %ds. Nothing else is worked meanwhile — out here or in the cabin.
zh_CN: 在舱里睡一觉：%d 秒血和精力都回满。这期间外面和船舱里都没人干活。

en: The way out: repair it, launch it, hold out
Nothing to make here yet — new materials bring new work.
zh_CN: 这里暂时没有能做的——有了新材料，才有新活。

en: %s: dinosaurs leave it when they die
Dawn. The coelophysis will be out again.
zh_CN: 天亮了，腔骨龙又要出来了。

en: Dusk. The coelophysis are going back to their nest.
Night. The coelophysis sleep — and the phytosaurs come up from the river. They keep out of firelight.
zh_CN: 天黑了。腔骨龙睡了——植龙从河里爬上来了。它们不敢进火光。

en: A raid is on its way
The nest's guards are warning you off. Back away — or they all come at once.
zh_CN: 巢的守卫在警告你：退开，不然它们会一起扑上来。

en: Dusk. The coelophysis are going home — and the dark is coming: the towers see only what firelight shows, and the phytosaurs come up from the river. Build a campfire by the towers, or light a torch (%s) — they keep out of firelight. Fire burns wood.
zh_CN: 黄昏了，腔骨龙回巢了。天要黑了：塔只看得见火光照着的恐龙，植龙会从河里爬上来。在塔边造一堆篝火，或者点一支火把（%s）——它们不敢进火光。火要烧木头。

en: The %s has no wood to burn tonight — it lights when there is some.
zh_CN: %s没有木头烧，今晚点不着——有了木头就会点着。

en: The torch has burnt out. Another costs %d wood (%s).
zh_CN: 火把烧完了。再点一支要 %d 木头（%s）。

en: The mist is ground you have not seen yet — walk there, or build near it, and it clears.
zh_CN: 雾里是还没去过的地方——走过去，或者在附近造东西，雾就散了。

en: Found: the coelophysis nest. Their raids set out from here — now you will see them go.
zh_CN: 找到了腔骨龙的巢：来袭从这里出发，以后它们一动身你就看得见。

en: The beacon charged, and the capsule jumped clear of the valley.
zh_CN: 信标充满了，船舱跳离了这片山谷。

en: The cabin was destroyed or the hero was killed!
zh_CN: 废弃船舱被毁或角色阵亡！

en: The cabin was broken open, and the way home with it.
zh_CN: 船舱被攻破了，回去的路也跟着断了。

en: The cabin's power ran out, and the way home with it.
zh_CN: 船舱的电用完了，回去的路也跟着断了。

en: The engineer fell. With nobody to mend the beacon, there is no way home.
zh_CN: 工程师倒下了。没人修信标，就回不去了。

en: The engineer worked himself into the ground. With nobody to mend the beacon, there is no way home.
zh_CN: 工程师累垮了。没人修信标，就回不去了。

en: The engineer was killed by the %s. With nobody to mend the beacon, there is no way home.
zh_CN: 工程师被%s咬死了。没人修信标，就回不去了。

en: The engineer was killed by the %s guarding their nest. With nobody to mend the beacon, there is no way home.
zh_CN: 工程师被守巢的%s咬死了。没人修信标，就回不去了。

en: %s takes a %s: make one at the %s (%s)
%s will not give way to bare hands — not yet.
Materials for %d of these %d — while any is red, none of them goes down
zh_CN: 材料只够 %d 段（拉了 %d 段）——有红的，这一排就一段也不造

en: Not enough materials: none of the %d built (%s short)
zh_CN: 材料不够，这 %d 段一段也没造（还差 %s）

en: The engineer can't get to the red ones — while any is red, none of them goes down
zh_CN: 工程师走不到红的那几段——有红的，这一排就一段也不造

en: The engineer can't get to %d of them: none built
zh_CN: 工程师走不到其中 %d 段，这一排一段也没造

en: R to turn a lone section — drag to lay a line
zh_CN: 按 R 转向单独的一段 —— 拖动可以拉一整排

en: Go home to the healing pod and sleep: health and stamina back, nothing else done meanwhile. Press again to climb out
zh_CN: 回船舱进营养舱睡一觉：回血也回精力，这期间什么都干不了。再按一下出来

en: Light a torch: %d wood; it burns %d s and lights %d m round you in the dark
zh_CN: 点一支火把：%d 木头，烧 %d 秒，在黑里照亮你周围 %d 米

en: Burning, %d s left. Press again to put it out
zh_CN: 正在烧，还剩 %d 秒。再按一下熄灭

en: Can't finish — something is standing where it goes
zh_CN: 盖不完 —— 有东西站在它的位置上

en: The engineer can't get there to build it
zh_CN: 工程师走不到那里，没法造

en: He is tired: sleep in the pod — it brings back health and stamina.
zh_CN: 他累了：进营养舱睡一觉，血和精力都会回来。

en: He is worn out and losing health — get him into the pod to sleep!
zh_CN: 他累垮了，在掉血——快让他进营养舱睡觉！

en: He can't get to the cabin's door

zh_CN: 烧着 · 照亮周围 %.0f 米

en: Lit at dusk — burns %d wood a night
zh_CN: 黄昏点着 · 每晚烧 %d 木头

en: No wood to burn — it lights when there is
zh_CN: 没有木头烧 · 有了就点着

en: Lumber Hut has no trees in range!
zh_CN: 伐木屋范围内无可用树木！

en: And the mouse: the wheel zooms · middle-drag moves the view, +Shift turns it · the cursor at the screen's edge moves it
zh_CN: 还有鼠标：滚轮缩放 · 中键拖动平移，按住 Shift 拖动旋转 · 鼠标移到屏幕边缘平移

en: Not while a raid is on its way or here
Not while dinosaurs are about -- wait till they have gone
zh_CN: 外面还有恐龙，等它们走了再存

en: Click, then press the key you want (Esc to keep this one)
zh_CN: 点一下，再按想用的键（Esc 不改）

en: And Esc steps back: what is in hand, a submenu, his card, a selection, then this menu
zh_CN: 还有 Esc 一层层往回退：手里的建筑、子菜单、他的属性、选中的东西，最后是这个菜单

en: %s  —  %s  ·  %.1fs  ·  lights %.0f m at night, burns %d wood a night
zh_CN: %s  —  %s  ·  %.1f 秒  ·  夜里照亮 %.0f 米，每晚烧 %d 木头

en: Two hundred million years from anyone who'd come looking.
zh_CN: 离会来找我的人，隔着两亿年。

en: The air's thick here. Richer than the ship's mix.
zh_CN: 这里的空气真浓，比舱里的配比还足。

en: No birds. Just insects, and those things.
zh_CN: 没有鸟。只有虫子，和那些东西。

en: I should check the hull seals again.
zh_CN: 该再查一遍舱体的密封了。

en: If the beacon works, someone hears it. If.
zh_CN: 信标修好了，就会有人听见。只要修得好。

en: Too quiet. I don't like quiet.
zh_CN: 太安静了。我不喜欢这么安静。

en: I'd trade this whole valley for a coffee.
zh_CN: 拿整个山谷换一杯咖啡，我都换。

en: Late Triassic. Hot, dry, and everything's hungry.
zh_CN: 晚三叠世。又热又干，什么都饿着。

en: Talking to myself again. Well, who else is there?
zh_CN: 又在自言自语了。不然还能跟谁说？

en: The stars are all wrong here. Of course they are.
zh_CN: 这里的星星全不在该在的地方。当然不在。

en: Conifer. Resin all over my hands.
A few more for the fence.
Keep an eye on those guards.
Another wall between me and them.
zh_CN: 我和它们之间，又多一道墙。

en: Can barely keep my eyes open.
I can't go on like this...

zh_CN: 浑身都疼。得赶紧去舱里。

en: I need to patch this up.
They're coming. I can hear them.
Here they come. Behind the wall.

zh_CN: 又是那叫声，它们出动了。
各就各位。好吧，就我一个。

en: That call came from %s. Here they come.
zh_CN: 叫声是从%s传来的，它们要来了。

en: There they go -- out of the nest.
They're leaving the nest. Coming this way.
zh_CN: 它们出巢了，正往这边来。

en: A %s, spooked -- it's going for the capsule! Fire turns it.
zh_CN: 一只%s受了惊，冲着船舱去了！它怕火。

en: That %s is charging the capsule. Arrows won't stop it -- fire will.
zh_CN: 那只%s要撞船舱。箭射不动它——它怕火。

en: That's the last of them. For now.
Time to pick up the pieces.
Take the big one down and they'll scatter.
zh_CN: 干掉大的，剩下的就散了。

en: Oh no. That's a big one.
That's what I was afraid of.
Stone Age engineering. I'll take it.
zh_CN: 石器时代的工程学。也行。
信号发出去了。现在，守住。

en: Let's see what needs doing in here.
zh_CN: 看看舱里有什么要做的。

en: The final wave is on its way
The signal is out, and they heard it. Build what you can.
zh_CN: 信号发出去了，它们也听见了。能修的赶紧修。

en: The beacon's hum carries down the valley. Something heard it.
zh_CN: 信标的嗡鸣传遍了山谷。有东西听见了。

en: Pick — he can quarry stone with one; made at the workbench
zh_CN: 镐 —— 有了才能采石，在工作台做

en: Axe — he fells trees faster; made at the workbench
zh_CN: 斧 —— 砍木头更快，在工作台做

en: The %s is in it. Right‐click it with the engineer selected to search it: %d s.
zh_CN: 里面有%s。选中工程师后右键点它，翻找 %d 秒。

en: %s: in the smoking wreck by the river, to the west
%s: in the smoking wreck to the north
%s: in the smoking wreck to the south‐east
The beacon's hum carries down the valley — something heard it. And it hears a distress call: the %s is in a wreck off to %s. Smoke is going up there.
zh_CN: 信标的嗡鸣传遍了山谷，有东西听见了。它也收到了一个求救信号：%s在%s的一块残骸里，那边升起了烟。

en: Found the %s — the beacon's stage %d takes it
zh_CN: 找到了%s——信标第 %d 段要用它

en: What went wrong? It is saved with a picture and the game's state as they were when you pressed. Enter saves, Shift+Enter starts a new line, Esc cancels.
zh_CN: 发生了什么？会和按下那一刻的截图、游戏状态一起存下来。回车保存，Shift+回车换行，Esc 取消。

en: e.g. the phytosaur stands at the firelight's edge and does not bite back when struck
zh_CN: 比如：植龙站在火光边上不动，我打它也不还手

en: Writes down everything the game is doing, with a picture of the screen (development builds only)
zh_CN: 把游戏此刻在做的一切写进文件，附一张截图（只有开发版有）

en: Right-click to pin it as your goal: the bar counts what it still takes
zh_CN: 右键钉成目标：材料栏会数着还差多少

en: Pinned as your goal — right-click again to unpin
zh_CN: 已钉成目标——再按右键取消

en: %s — %s · %.1fs — stabs %.1f as it is stepped on, and slows what is on it to %d%%; in nobody's way
zh_CN: %s —— %s · %.1f 秒 —— 踩上去扎 %.1f，在上面只能走 %d%% 的速度；不挡路

en: The clanging carries to the river — something is coming up out of the water.
zh_CN: 翻找的响声传到了河边——有东西从水里爬上来了。

en: The clanging has woken a guard at the nest.
zh_CN: 翻找的响声吵醒了巢边的守卫。

en: The clanging carries down the valley — a pack is coming in from its edge.
zh_CN: 翻找的响声顺着山谷传开——一群从山谷边上进来了。

en: draws where he has been: a map at the top left
zh_CN: 画下走过的地方：左上角出现小地图

en: The map is in the corner: where you have been, the cabin, the smoking wrecks. Click it to look there.
zh_CN: 地图在角上了：画着去过的地方、船舱、冒烟的残骸。点它，视角就过去。

en: Stranded in the age of dinosaurs: hold the cabin, and find the way home.
zh_CN: 困在恐龙的时代：守住船舱，找到回去的路。

en: Station 1, the Late Triassic valley: mend the ship's beacon from what the wrecks hold, and jump home.
zh_CN: 第 1 站，晚三叠世的山谷：从残骸里找回部件，修好飞船的信标，跳回去。

en: Choose the age, the difficulty, the map and more. The cabin is whole and its beacon is calling: hold out till the rescue comes.
zh_CN: 自己选纪元、难度、地图……船舱是完整的，信标已经在呼叫救援：撑到救援来。

en: The same seed plays the same raids at the same times. Leave it empty for a new one each run.
zh_CN: 同一个种子，来袭的时间和数量都一样。留空就每局不同。

en: Coelophysis packs by day, Hesperosuchus with them from the third day, phytosaurs up out of the river at night; the boss is Postosuchus.
zh_CN: 白天腔骨龙成群来，第 3 天起黄昏鳄跟着来，夜里植龙从河里上岸；大首领是波斯特鳄。

en: Feathered Velociraptor packs, day and night, pterosaurs with them from the third day; the boss is Tyrannosaurus.
zh_CN: 长羽毛的迅猛龙成群来，白天夜里都来，第 3 天起翼龙跟着来；大首领是霸王龙。

en: One nest. Smaller, softer raids, further apart, and only from the nest.
zh_CN: 一个巢。来袭少、弱、隔得久，只从巢那边来。

en: One nest. The raids as the game itself has them.
zh_CN: 一个巢。来袭和正式游戏一样。

en: Two nests. Bigger, tougher raids, sooner and oftener, and from more ways in.
zh_CN: 两个巢。来袭更多、更硬、更早、更密，从更多方向进来。

en: Three nests. Every raid worse than the last.
88 metres across: the nest far off past a ridge, a stone forest, woods.
zh_CN: 88 米见方：巢在远处的山梁后面，有石林、树林。

en: The beacon is calling. Hold out %d more days.
zh_CN: 信标在呼叫救援。还要撑 %d 天。

en: The beacon is calling. The rescue comes at first light.
zh_CN: 信标在呼叫救援。天一亮，救援就到。

en: You held out for %d days, and the rescue the beacon called has come.
zh_CN: 你撑过了 %d 天，信标招来的救援到了。

en: %s: %s damage each, and on through up to %d in a line.
zh_CN: %s：每支伤害 %s，一箭最多穿过 %d 只。

en: %s: everything within %s m of where it falls takes %s, is knocked flat %ss and shoved off %s m — not the big ones.
zh_CN: %s：落点 %s 米内的都挨 %s 伤害，砸倒 %s 秒，推开 %s 米——推不动大的。

en: %s: everything within %s m of where it falls takes %s, is knocked flat %ss and shoved off %s m — the big ones too.
zh_CN: %s：落点 %s 米内的都挨 %s 伤害，砸倒 %s 秒，推开 %s 米——大的也推得动。

en: %s: everything within %s m of where it lands takes %s, and is knocked flat %ss.
zh_CN: %s：落点 %s 米内的都挨 %s 伤害，砸倒 %s 秒。

en: Ammunition — a batch at a time, shot away
zh_CN: 弹药 —— 做一批，打一批

en: Empty — there is some in the stock: walk him past it, or Load
zh_CN: 空了 —— 库存里有：让人走过去，或者点装填

en: %s — %s · %.1fs — shoots anything within %.0f m, flying or not; comes loaded: %d arrows
zh_CN: %s —— %s · %.1f 秒 —— 射 %.0f 米内的一切，飞的也射；造好就装满 %d 支箭

en: %s — %s · %.1fs — drops a log on what comes within %.1f m of its foot: crushed, knocked flat, shoved off; comes loaded: %d logs
zh_CN: %s —— %s · %.1f 秒 —— 往脚下 %.1f 米内的恐龙砸木头：砸伤、砸倒、推开；造好就装满 %d 根

en: %s — %s · %.1fs — turns and throws at the thick of a crowd %.0f–%.0f m off: crushes, not what flies; comes loaded: %d shot
zh_CN: %s —— %s · %.1f 秒 —— 转过去往 %.0f～%.0f 米外最密的地方扔石头：砸一片，打不到飞的；造好就装满 %d 发

en: %s — %s · %.1fs — what eats meat and passes within %.0f m stops to eat a few seconds, once each; comes with %d pieces of meat on it
zh_CN: %s —— %s · %.1f 秒 —— 吃肉的恐龙从 %.0f 米内经过会停下吃几秒，每只一次；造好就挂上 %d 块肉

en: The %s holds nothing yet: make %s at the workbench, then walk him past it — he loads it.
zh_CN: %s还是空的：去工作台做%s，再让人从塔边走过——他会装上。

en: The %s holds nothing yet: %s from the stock goes on it when he walks past.
zh_CN: %s还是空的：人从旁边走过，就把库存里的%s挂上去。

en: Ornitholestes packs by day, Harpactognathus on the wing with them from the second day; the boss is Allosaurus.
zh_CN: 白天嗜鸟龙成群来，第 2 天起猎颌翼龙从天上跟着来；首领是异特龙。
美国西南部 · 钦尔组
美国西部 · 莫里森组

en: The cabin and his tools came with him. The stock, and everything he built, stayed behind.
zh_CN: 船舱和工具跟着跳了过来；库存的材料和造的东西，都留在了上一站。

en: %s — a new valley. Find the wrecks, and mend the beacon again.
zh_CN: %s——新的山谷。找残骸，再把信标修好。

en: The capsule came down hard -- the whole valley heard it. Whatever lives here will come to ram the strange thing. Hold it.
zh_CN: 船舱砸进了山谷，整个山谷都听见了。这里的恐龙会来撞这个怪东西——守住它！

en: The beacon came down with me, but it's broken. Fix it, and someone hears me.
zh_CN: 信标还在，可摔坏了。修好它，才发得出求救信号。

en: And the capsule's battery won't last more than a few days.
zh_CN: 救生舱的电池，也撑不了几天。

en: The ship broke up over this valley. Only the capsule came down, with you in it.
zh_CN: 飞船在这个山谷上空解体了，只有救生舱载着你落了地。

en: Repair the beacon to call for rescue: three stages, each needing a part from a wreck in the valley.
zh_CN: 修好信标才能求救：一共三段，每段要山谷里一处残骸里的零件。

en: The capsule's battery lasts about %d days. When it runs out, it is over.
zh_CN: 救生舱的电池大约能用 %d 天，用完就输了。

en: The crash frightened the valley's dinosaurs. They will come to ram the capsule.
zh_CN: 坠落惊动了山谷里的恐龙，它们会来撞救生舱。

en: All of this is in the journal (%s).
The capsule's power: %d%%, about %s days left
zh_CN: 救生舱的电：%d%%，大约还能用 %s 天
按 %s 或 Esc 关上

en: The jump went wrong. The ship broke up over a valley two hundred million years ago; only the crew capsule came down whole, with me in it.
zh_CN: 跃迁出了故障。飞船在两亿年前的一个山谷上空解体，只有救生舱完整地落了地，我在里面。

en: The beacon can send a call home. It takes three stages repaired, each with materials and a part from the wrecks scattered over the valley; then it is launched, and the capsule held while it charges. The capsule's power will not wait.
zh_CN: 信标能把求救信号发回去。要修三段，每段要材料，还要一个零件，零件在山谷里散落的残骸里；修好以后启动它，充能的时候守住船舱。救生舱的电不等人。

en: Its hum carries down the valley. Something will have heard it.
zh_CN: 它的嗡嗡声传遍了山谷，有东西听见了。

en: Everything in the valley heard it. Hold the capsule till it is charged.
zh_CN: 整个山谷都听见了。守住船舱，直到充满。

en: The Late Jurassic's dry valley, as big as the large one; clay on the river bank.
zh_CN: 晚侏罗世干燥的河谷，和大山谷一样大；河岸上有黏土。

en: %s: everything within %s m of where it breaks takes %s, and the ground burns %ss.
zh_CN: %s：碎开的地方 %s 米内的都挨 %s 伤害，地上烧 %s 秒。

en: Dawn. The ornitholestes will be out again, and the harpactognathus over them.
zh_CN: 天亮了，嗜鸟龙又要出来了，天上还有猎颌翼龙。

en: Dusk. The ornitholestes are going back to their nest.
Night. The ornitholestes sleep, and nothing comes up out of this river — but you will see little in the dark.
zh_CN: 天黑了。嗜鸟龙睡了，这条河夜里没有东西爬上来——但黑里看不远。

en: Dusk. The ornitholestes are going home — and the dark is coming: the towers see only what firelight shows. Build a campfire by the towers, or light a torch (%s). Fire burns wood.
zh_CN: 黄昏了，嗜鸟龙回巢了。天要黑了：塔只看得见火光照着的恐龙。在塔边造一堆篝火，或者点一支火把（%s）。火要烧木头。

en: Dawn. The raptors hunt by day as they did by night.
zh_CN: 天亮了。迅猛龙白天也出来，和夜里一样。

en: Dusk. The raptors do not go home: they hunt in the dark too.
zh_CN: 黄昏了。迅猛龙不回巢：黑里它们也出来。

en: Night. The raptors are still out — and you will see little in the dark.
zh_CN: 天黑了。迅猛龙还在外面——黑里看不远。

en: Dusk. The dark is coming: the towers see only what firelight shows, and the raptors hunt on through it. Build a campfire by the towers, or light a torch (%s). Fire burns wood.
zh_CN: 黄昏了。天要黑了：塔只看得见火光照着的恐龙，迅猛龙黑里也出来。在塔边造一堆篝火，或者点一支火把（%s）。火要烧木头。

en: Load: he goes and fills it from the stock. He also loads it whenever he walks past.
zh_CN: 装填：人过去从库存把它装满。人从旁边走过时也会顺手装上。

en: He is on his way to load it.
Nothing in the stock to load it with.
